newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Avonmore disappointed by Waterford rejection.
newsitem.headline: Avonmore disappointed by Waterford rejection.

text.p: Avonmore Foods Plc said on Tuesday that it was disappointed that Waterford Foods Plc and Waterford Co-Operative Society Ltd could not endorse its merger proposals.
It said its proposals had been described by a number of commentators as generous.
But it welcomed Waterford's statement that it agreed with the concept of merger or industry consolidation.
"The boards of Avonmore will consider the Waterford statement in due course and will discuss the matter with their financial advisers, IBI Corporate Finance," Avonmore said in a statement.
Waterford said it was not endorsing the merger proposal because it did not reflect the underlying value of the Waterford business.
Avonmore's proposals would have created a merged entity with turnover in excess of 2.5 billion Irish pounds.
